run_tokenize_cpp_source: run the C++ tokenizer on a source file and print each token type and name to stdout
create_GetTokens_generator: create a generator that yields Token objects for each token found in C++ source code
build_Token_class: build a Token data container with token_type, name, start index, and end index attributes
summarize_GetString_helper: summarize the _GetString helper that finds the closing quote of a double-quoted string handling backslash escapes
review_GetChar_helper: review the _GetChar helper that finds the closing quote of a single-quoted char literal handling backslash escapes
